suggestions.title: Optimize Largest Contentful Paint Image Loading
suggestions.description: The largest image on your page, the LCP element, isn't optimally loaded, affecting your LCP metric. This can be improved by setting a high fetch priority for this image and ensuring the rendering engine knows its importance early.
suggestions.implementation: Use JavaScript to dynamically set fetch priority to high for the LCP image.

suggestions.title: Deferral of Non-Critical Third-Party Scripts
suggestions.description: The `auth0-spa-js.production.js` script is loaded too early and contributes to rendering delay. It should be moved to a non-blocking execution post-LCP.
suggestions.implementation: Load the script asynchronously during the loadDelayed phase.
suggestions.codeExample: function loadDelayed() { window.setTimeout(() => { import('./delayed.js'); loadScript('https://cdn.auth0.com/js/auth0-spa-js/2.0/auth0-spa-js.production.js', { async: true }); }, 3000); }

suggestions.title: Implement Code Splitting for Auth0 JavaScript
suggestions.description: The `auth0-spa-js.production.js` file contains a significant amount of unused code pre-LCP, which increases the resource blocking time.
suggestions.implementation: Consider refactoring this script into smaller, more focused modules that can be loaded as needed.

suggestions.title: Optimize CSS Delivery
suggestions.description: Some CSS is render-blocking, which delays LCP. Ensure only critical CSS is included in the render path, and move other styles to `lazy-styles.css`.
suggestions.implementation: Refactor `styles.css` by moving non-critical styles to `lazy-styles.css` and ensuring only necessary styles are initially loaded.

suggestions.title: Reduce Cumulative Layout Shift by Defining Image Dimensions
suggestions.description: Images on the page do not explicitly specify dimensions, contributing to layout shifts. Each image must have defined width and height attributes or aspect ratios.
suggestions.implementation: Use JavaScript to apply the correct aspect ratio (using CSS property) and ensure appropriate widths and heights are defined dynamically.
